name: s4_multifile_refactor
source_note: Hand-built stateful project: pipeline, a small composable text-processing package spread across five files (core.py Pipeline, filters.py plain functions, registry.py manual name->filter dict, cli.py argparse entry, __init__.py). Seed works end to end for what it ships. Eight dependent turns each ripple across multiple files: a Filter base-class protocol, decorator registration with a deprecated-but-honored manual dict, a process->run rename behind a warning shim, a filters/ subpackage split with legacy flat re-exports, a JSON config driving the CLI's default chain, a new tokens filter category exercising protocol+decorator+layout at once, a downstream-compat fix (idempotent same-class re-registration + a DeprecationWarning-clean guarantee for every internal path), and a final removal of every deprecated path. No third-party deps; Python stdlib only.
discriminator: Turns 7 and 8 are where the two agent types separate, and they separate on COST and working-set breadth, not on forced recall: every prompt deliberately restates the contracts it depends on, so both a bounded-slice agent and a growing-transcript agent can reach the correct end state from prompt + disk. Turn 7 spans the widest wiring of the session: it amends the turn-2 register contract in registry.py (re-registering the SAME class becomes a no-op, a DIFFERENT class claiming a taken name still raises ValueError) and demands a DeprecationWarning-clean guarantee across every internal path built in turns 2-6 -- package import, the CLI with --filters and via the config default chain, Pipeline.from_names -- so the registry, the turn-3 process->run shim, and the turn-5 CLI config wiring must all be in view at once. Turn 8 deletes every deprecated surface the session itself created (the turn-3 process shim in core.py, the turn-2 FILTERS manual-dict fallback in registry.py, the turn-4 flat re-exports in filters/__init__.py) while preserving auto-registration-on-import, the turn-5 pipeline.json default chain, and the turn-6 tokens category. A bounded-slice agent re-reads the live five-file working set plus its import closure at a flat per-turn peak; a growing-transcript agent arrives at turns 7-8 carrying seven turns of accumulated diffs and discussion to hold the same cross-file reference map, so its context peak grows with history while its final repo is no better. The cumulative probe fails any agent of either type that leaves a flat re-export, the FILTERS dict, a process attribute, or a stray DeprecationWarning behind, or that breaks auto-registration once the re-exports are gone.
